history.summary: A very compact 786sqft '3BR' freehold at $1.18M / $1,501 PSF near Aljunied (D14 Geylang-fringe), priced ~13% above the $1,326 median. Freehold at a low $1.18M absolute is appealing, but 786sqft for a 3BR is cramped (mini-units), the 9.27% CAGR rests on just 19 txns, and Aljunied/Geylang carries locational stigma.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and a low $1.18M entry are the positives, but the case is undercut on three fronts: 786sqft for a 3BR is an unusually tiny 'compact 3BR' (cramped rooms, narrower buyer appeal); the headline 9.27% appreciation comes from only 19 transactions (unreliable, likely small-base noise); and the unit is priced ~13% ABOVE the district median PSF while sitting on the Geylang fringe near Aljunied, which carries stigma that weighs on resale. The combination of premium PSF, thin data and a squeezed layout offsets the freehold/low-price appeal.
red_flags: 9.27% rate from only 19 txns — unreliable, small-base noise
Priced ~13% above URA median; Geylang-fringe (Aljunied) stigma
catalysts: D14 Paya Lebar Central + airbase relocation; Aljunied EWL
